summary: Derived from Josu San Martin's all-distinct-spacing (2026-11-22, Apache-2.0). Its certificate, the constants c and B, the counting argument and the three final statements are unchanged. The only change is the proved lower bound for the window constant H_W = 3/2 − cos t/(√2 sin t) − PAM/(2 sin² t), t = √2/2, in the score (1 + H − B)/(2 − c). The record bounds π to 40 decimals inside PAM, which costs its floor 17,165 units of 10^-50. Here π is bounded to 46 decimals with Mathlib's pi_upper_bound (76 witnesses), the cosine literal is lowered to the ceiling of the file's own polynomial bound, and a sine lemma is re-derived from that cosine by sin² + cos² = 1. The floor rises by 17,239 units of 10^-50, to within 4 units of H_W, and the score by 8.66e-47. No new mathematics. A change notice is at the top of the file; all upstream notices are retained.
method: H_W floor of all-distinct-spacing sharpened: π bounded to 46 decimals (was 40), cosine and sine literals tightened; certificate and counting argument unchanged
